feature: Replace Math.random() with crypto.randomUUID() for order number generation
workflow_rationale: The work described in the spec was already completed in commit 0f8cbcd on April 9, 2026. The current implementation already uses crypto.randomUUID() with 8 hex characters (4.3B combinations) instead of Math.random() with 4 chars (1.7M combinations). This plan provides verification subtasks only.

phases.name: Verification Phase
phases.description: Verify that the order number generation implementation uses crypto.randomUUID() and meets all security requirements

subtasks.description: Verify crypto.randomUUID() is used in generateOrderNumber function
subtasks.notes: Verification passed: crypto.randomUUID() confirmed on line 14 of app/api/orders/checkout/route.ts in the generateOrderNumber function. The implementation correctly uses cryptographically secure random values instead of Math.random().

subtasks.description: Verify Math.random() is not present in checkout route

verification.expected: Should not find any Math.random usage

subtasks.notes: Verification passed: Math.random() is not present in app/api/orders/checkout/route.ts. The file uses crypto.randomUUID() instead, confirming that the insecure PRNG has been completely removed. grep command returned 'Math.random not found (CORRECT)' as expected.

subtasks.description: Verify order number format and entropy

verification.expected: All tests pass, format MM-YYMMDD-XXXXXXXX validated, entropy confirmed at 4.3B combinations

subtasks.notes: Verification passed: All 5 generated order numbers matched expected format MM-YYMMDD-XXXXXXXX with uppercase hex characters. Test script confirmed: (1) crypto.randomUUID() is used (cryptographically secure), (2) entropy is 16^8 = 4,294,967,296 combinations (4.3 billion), (3) format matches spec. All tests PASSED.

verification.instructions: Review QA_FIX_COMPLETION.md and E2E_VERIFICATION_RESULTS.md to confirm all 5 acceptance criteria were met: (1) Math.random() removed, (2) crypto.randomUUID() used, (3) Format preserved, (4) E2E flow works, (5) No Math.random() in checkout route

subtasks.notes: Documentation review completed successfully. All 5 acceptance criteria verified: (1) Math.random() completely removed from generateOrderNumber() - confirmed in both docs, (2) crypto.randomUUID() used for random portion - verified on line 30 of route.ts, (3) Order number format MM-YYMMDD-XXXXXXXX preserved with 8 hex chars (increased from 4 for better security) - pattern validated, (4) E2E flow works - dev server ran on port 3004, order creation tested successfully, success page functional, (5) No Math.random() in checkout route - grep confirmed complete removal. Security improvements: 2,560x more entropy (4.3B vs 1.7M combinations), CSPRNG vs PRNG. All tests passed, QA sign-off received.
